n = int(input())
and_op = 1023  # All bits set to 1
or_op = 0  # All bits set to 0
xor_op = 0  # No change

for _ in range(n):
    op, x = input().split()
    x = int(x)
    if op == '&':
        and_op &= x
        or_op &= x
    elif op == '|':
        and_op |= x
        or_op |= x
    elif op == '^':
        and_op ^= x
        or_op ^= x

# Simplify the operations to fit within 5 lines
and_simplified = 1023
or_simplified = 0
xor_simplified = 0

# Determine the simplified operations

    for x in range(1024):
        result_petya = (x & and_op) | or_op
        result_ours = (x & and_simplified) | or_simplified
        if result_petya != result_ours:
            xor_simplified ^= 1
    and_simplified &= (and_simplified ^ 1023)
    or_simplified |= (or_simplified ^ 0)

# Output the simplified program
if xor_simplified != 0:
    print(1)
    print('^ 1')
elif or_simplified != 0:
    print(1)
    print('| 1')
else:
    print(0)
